## math.orderflow — trade classification, flow imbalance, VPIN, book and footprint maths

Does: Order-flow and microstructure maths from quotes, prints and depth, including footprint bars built from the tape.
Needs: Quotes, trade prints or depth snapshots from the market block.

Types:
- `TradeClassifier` — Deciding who was the aggressor on a print, for feeds that do not say.
  - `TradeSide Classify(TradePrint trade, Quote? quote)` — The venue's own answer where it has one, and the quote rule where it does not.
  - `TradeSide QuoteRule(double price, double bid, double ask)` — The Lee-Ready quote rule: at or through the offer is a buy, at or through the bid a sell, and anything strictly inside is decided against the mid.
  - `TradeSide TickRule(double price, double previousPrice, TradeSide previousSide)` — The tick rule: an uptick is a buy, a downtick a sell, and an unchanged price inherits the previous classification.
- `TradeSide: Unknown | Buy | Sell` — Which side crossed the spread to make a trade happen.
- `new OrderFlowImbalance(int period = 100)` — Signed traded volume over a rolling window, normalised to [-1, 1]. · `IEstimator` · `Period` · `Cumulative` · `WindowDelta` · `Update(double volume, TradeSide side)` · `Update(TradePrint trade, Quote? quote)`
- `new Vpin(double bucketVolume, int buckets = 50)` — Volume-Synchronised Probability of Informed Trading — how one-sided the flow has been, bucketed by volume rather than by time. · `IEstimator` · `BucketVolume` · `BucketCount` · `BucketProgress` · `Update(double volume, TradeSide side)`
- `new KyleLambda(int period = 60)` — Kyle's lambda: how far price moves per unit of signed volume — the market's depth, measured rather than read off the book. · `IEstimator` · `Period` · `RSquared` · `ImpactOf(double signedUnits)` · `Record(double volume, TradeSide side)` · `Close(double price)`
- `Book` — What the resting book says about where the next trade will happen — the statistics that turn a depth snapshot into a number a strategy can act on.
  - `double Microprice(double bidPrice, double bidSize, double askPrice, double askSize)` — The size-weighted mid: the fair value implied by the queues rather than by the prices alone.
  - `double Microprice(Quote quote)` — The microprice of a quote.
  - `double Microprice(DepthSnapshot depth)` — The microprice at the top of a depth snapshot.
  - `double Imbalance(double bidSize, double askSize)` — Queue imbalance at the touch, in [-1, 1] — positive when the bid is larger.
  - `double Imbalance(Quote quote)` — Queue imbalance at the touch of a quote.
  - `double Imbalance(DepthSnapshot depth, int levels)` — Imbalance over the first `levels` of each side.
  - `double DepthTotal(IReadOnlyList<DepthLevel>? side, int levels)` — Resting size over the first `levels` of one side.
  - `double SweepPrice(IReadOnlyList<DepthLevel>? side, double units)` — What it costs to take `units` immediately, as a size-weighted price walking the book.
  - `double SweepSlippage(IReadOnlyList<DepthLevel>? side, double units, double reference)` — The slippage a sweep of `units` would pay against `reference`, in price units.
- `new SpreadStats(int period = 200)` — Rolling statistics of the bid-ask spread, so "the spread blew out" can be said in the instrument's own terms. · `IEstimator` · `Period` · `Mean` · `StandardDeviation` · `Median` · `ZScore` · `IsWide(double deviations = 2)` · `Update(double spread)` · `Update(Quote quote)`
- `new FootprintTimeBucketer(TimeSpan span, double tickSize, FeedQuality quality)` — Stateful time-bucketer for footprint bars: accumulates `FootprintPrint`s into fixed wall-clock buckets (`bucket = ts − ts mod span`) and seals the prior bucket into a… · `CurrentBucketStart` · `CumulativeDelta` · `Add(FootprintPrint print)` · `BuildForming()` · `Reset(long cumulativeDeltaSeed = 0)`
- `FootprintFeatures` — Stateless / streaming footprint feature extractor.
  - `FootprintBar BuildBar(IReadOnlyList<FootprintPrint> prints, double tickSize, DateTime startUtc, DateTime endUtc, FeedQuality quality, long cumulativeDeltaBefore = 0, FootprintExtractorOptions options = default)` — Builds one `FootprintBar` from a slice of prints.
  - `double SuggestRowSize(double barAtr, double instrumentTickSize, int targetRows = 20)` — Suggested price-bucket size for a footprint bar so it shows roughly `targetRows` rows: `tickSize ≈ ATR_bar / targetRows`, then snapped up to a multiple of the instrument…
  - `IEnumerable<FootprintPrint> SyntheticPrints(IEnumerable<ValueTuple<double, long, double, double, DateTime>> updates)` — Synthesizes pseudo trade-prints from a sequence of L1 quote/last updates via the Lee-Ready / tick-rule classifier (`ClassifyAggressor`).
- `FootprintPrint(double Price, long Size, AggressorSide Aggressor, DateTime TimeUtc)` — A single trade print reduced to the four fields the footprint extractor cares about: price, size, aggressor side and event time.
- `FootprintBar(DateTime StartUtc, DateTime EndUtc, IReadOnlyList<FootprintFeatureRow> Rows, double PocPrice, double VolumeCentroid, double BuyCentroid, double SellCentroid, long BuyVolume, long SellVolume, long Delta, long CumulativeDelta, int StackedBuy, int StackedSell, FeedQuality Quality)` — A completed footprint bar: per-price rows plus the bar-level aggregates that the v2 Apex estimators consume — POC, total-volume centroid, the NEW buy- and sell-volume centroids… · `TotalVolume`
- `FootprintFeatureRow(double Price, long BuyVolume, long SellVolume, bool BidImbalance, bool AskImbalance, bool ZeroBid, bool ZeroAsk)` — One price row of a footprint bar: buy- and sell-initiated volume that printed inside the row's price bucket, plus the diagonal-imbalance flags computed against neighbouring rows. · `TotalVolume` · `Delta`

Limits: FootprintTimeBucketer is stateful and single-threaded: one per instrument, fed in time order.
